verdict.rationale: Preventing training on user data is a fair question for an LLM gateway like Requesty, so the axis applies. The pack has no training opt-out, zero-data-retention routing, or no-training provider filter. Guardrails (scanning for sensitive content) and EU routing (data residency) are adjacent privacy controls, not a way to stop data being used for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
